summary: A color, picked inline from a hue slider, nine shades and a hex field, or from a popover with a saturation and brightness area.

props.name: value
props.description: The color, as a hex like `#5b4bdb`. Controlled; pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The color it starts on when uncontrolled. Without one, the middle shade of a violet.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new hex whenever the color changes.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Colors one press away, under the hex field. Popover only.

props.name: opacity
props.description: An opacity slider under the hue slider. Below 100% the value carries two more hex digits, as in `#5b4bdb80`. Popover only.

props.name: variant
props.description: `inline` shows a hue slider, nine shades and a hex field in place. `popover` puts any color behind a swatch button: a saturation and brightness area, a hue slider, a hex field and `swatches`.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the shades, the field & the swatch. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks every part of the picker & dims it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`, which is right almost always; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.
